QuestInfo.name: [Ellinel Fairy Academy] Fairynappers
QuestInfo.0: Fanzy the cat, one of Grendel the Really Old's pupils, would like your help in the North Forest's Giant Tree.
QuestInfo.1: Fanzy the cat wants you to go to the Ellinel Fairy Academy. You can find the entrance at the bottom of the North Forest Giant Tree.
QuestInfo.2: Fanzy has a favor to ask. Go to the Lake in front of the Ellinel Fairy Academy for details.

0.0: Meeeowwww, you're a funny lookin' human. I hope you're not coming to take classes, because I am #bGrendel's#k number one pupil.
0.1: It wasn't easy, no-siree. It takes dedication and smarts.\r\nYou can bask in #bmy glory#k if you'd like.
0.2: What were we talking about? Me, right? Of course me.
0.3: #fNpc/1500011.img/stand/0#\r\nIf you're overwhelmed by the sheer magnitude of my amazingness, I'd recommend talking to #bCootie the Really Small#k. He's another of Grendel's pupils, but his bulb isn't quite so bright.
0.4: #fNpc/1500000.img/stand/0##fNpc/1500002.img/stand/0#\r\nHe's been a little bit of a weirdo since those fairies captured him. I've heard he even took to #e#rkidnapping fairies#k#n of his own... Can't say I blame him, they're so fun to bat around.
0.5: Help me or don't. I've got plenty of grooming myself to do...

yes.0: There's a secret path down below that the fairies just seem to love. I bet there's something deliciously fun to do in there...\r\n(#bNorth Forest: Take the bottom tunnel in the Giant Tree to reach #bEllinel Lake Shore#k.)
What kind of pupil will you be if you're this slow to walk somewhere?

npc.0: Do you see the tunnel there? That's the path the fairies take into the forest. Go have a look...\r\n#b(Travel down the Ellinel Lake Shore to get to the Fairy Academy.)#k
